task_definition.task_description: Please check if the black Sony XM5 headphones are in stock, then show me some alternative audio recommendations, and if they’re available go ahead and place the order for 1 using PayPal. After that, get the current BTC price and an AAPL quote, archive the AAPL quote snapshot for me, then use the BTC quote details to resolve the profile and place a sell order for 0.25 shares of AAPL at that USD price, and finally send me a post-trade checking balance summary in the app.

user_input.query: Hi, for user_123 with medium priority, please check whether the black Sony XM5 headphones are in stock in the audio category. The product is p_sony_xm5_blk, and in my items list I have { product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1 }. If they’re available, please place the order for quantity 1 using paypal, and also show me some alternative audio recommendations. Then get the current BTC price in USD and an AAPL quote, archive the AAPL quote snapshot for me with the title BTC Quote Archive, and use the BTC quote details to resolve the profile and place a sell order for 0.25 shares of AAPL at that USD price. Finally, send me a Post-Trade Balance Summary for my checking account in the app channel.
